data.description: transcribe.cpp/ggml-metal's residency loop (ggml-metal-device.m ~954-1003, usleep 5 ms) wakes the process ~210x/s while the Metal device exists. A ~40-line semaphore patch would let it sleep when idle with no latency cost. Offer it upstream to handy-computer/transcribe.cpp (and possibly ggml/llama.cpp). Ask Brandon before opening anything upstream.
data.title: Offer the ggml-metal idle-loop patch upstream
